blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Recognises 'Sahamati' as Self-Regulatory Organisation for Account Aggregator Ecosystem. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Sahamati becomes official SRO for NBFC-Account Aggregator network powering consent-based data sharing.
SRO Recognition: RBI recognised Sahamati (not-for-profit entity) as SRO for Account Aggregator ecosystem.
AA Framework: Consent-based financial data sharing launched Sept 2, 2021; enabled ₹3.5 lakh crore lending in FY26.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
